newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Enersis first-half net rises.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Enersis first-half net rises.

text.p: Chilean power investment company Enersis said its first half profits rose eight percent to 68.77 billion pesos from 63.88 billion pesos in the same period last year.
Just over 45 percent of the company's profits came from its investments in Argentina, Peru and Colombia, the statement said.
In Chile, Enersis controls power generator Endesa and distributor Chilectra.
The utility reported consolidated sales of 610 billion pesos, up four percent on the first six months of 1996.

Operating earnings came to 155 billion pesos, down 11.4 percent on the January-June period last year. Non-operating earnings rose 54 percent to 24 billion pesos. ((-- Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
